answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit bond and shows one work token earned that epoch. The token is issued on a whisper channel tied to its earner, cannot be transferred, and expires at the epoch zenith. A spiral ledger records serials once; a serial shown twice burns both bonds, and a zenith auditor rechecks 5% of jobs and burns the bond on mismatch. The k-th fake costs 130 credits, 90 bond plus 40 job cost, so 1,000 fakes lock 130,000 credits and need 1,000 jobs. A rented-token ring fails: a serial tied to its earner mismatches any presenter. An honest agent pays once: one bond and one job.
